reason: Freeside MUST NOT promote bot-side conversation buffers, vector-store hits, or message scrollback into a RecallPack. A Discord conversation buffer is bot context, not governed recall. A RecallPack only exists if the request ran through the runtime gate, the policy lane returned a non-deny decision, the disposition matrix was applied, and a RecallReceipt was emitted and persisted.
